note: FNS Section 900 is the introductory header for Chapter 9 (Resources), stating only that the chapter covers general requirements for verification of resources and pointing to Sections 711.1/712.1 for verification timeframes. The OLG has comprehensive resource/asset verification coverage across multiple pages: 'Assets Overview - SNAP' covers asset limits ($3,000/$4,500), countable vs non-countable assets, categorical eligibility exemptions, and mandatory verification requirements; 'SNAP Asset Guidelines' covers verification of bank deposits/joint accounts (within 45 days), securities verification (multiple acceptable documents), lump sum payment verification, verification of ownership rules, and non-liquid asset equity valuation; BEACON procedure pages cover entering liquid assets, financial holdings, pensions, and real property data with verification-on-the-fly functionality. The OLG adequately addresses the general resource verification framework that Section 900 introduces.
